chunk: Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output. Risk Management and Mitigation • Quality Risk: AI outputs might be inaccurate or unengaging. Mitigation: Maintain humans-in-loop for review, start with conservative content generation, gather student feedback early. • Data/Copyright Risk: Unauthorized use of licensed content. Mitigation: Legal review of sources, use public/open data, ensure model outputs are sufficiently rephrased. Overruns: Training large models can blow budgets. Mitigation: Emphasize quality (pilot studies), build trust via transparency (model cards, citing sources), include teachers in loops. • Technical Risk: GPU hardware failures or cloud outages. Mitigation: Redundancy, cloud fallback, robust monitoring/alerts. • Regulatory Risk: New laws (data privacy) may affect operations. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output.
